_source: Whimsical Gothic Storybook art direction (2026-11-15), living room art test. storybook_rooms: rooms drawn in the new style; others keep the placeholder look until approved. sprites: optional painted images replacing code-drawn props, keyed by furniture kind or kind:variant (variant = the piece's 'variant' in furniture.json). Each entry: sprite (res:// path to a PNG/WebP), states (visual state -> path; e.g. fireplace burning/out, lamp lit/out, window closed/open), anchor ([x, y] of the image, 0..1, that sits on the piece's floor position; default bottom centre [0.5, 1.0]), scale (size at the front of the room; depth scaling is applied on top). Empty or missing files fall back to the code drawing. Gameplay data (footprints, sight blockers, hiding spots, interaction range) never depends on these images. See assets/art/props/sprite_guide.md.
_wall_portraits: Art Phase 1 (2026-11-15): framed portraits on the side walls, per storybook room. Art config only: not furniture, never an obstacle, not in furniture.json. wall: left/right; v: [from, to] along the wall (0 back .. 1 front; side doors are at 0.39-0.61); h: [from, to] up the wall (0 floor .. 1 top; wainscot up to 0.36); variant: lady / child / gentleman.
_wear: Art Phase 2 (2026-11-15): how worn a room looks; presentation only (RoomWear, RoomStage). Shown in every room. fade_per_second: how fast dirt/polish/cold appear and fade (real seconds). Dirt: dull_alpha (brown-grey wash over floor and walls), dust_patches / dust_alpha (dust and every third a stain, never within door_clear floor units of a door, inside floor_margin), web_alpha / web_radius (cobwebs in the top corners), web_tops (cobweb on top of tall furniture: kind -> [x, y] local px of its top-left corner), motes / mote_alpha (dust specks drifting in the light). Clean: polish_alpha (sheen bands on the floor). Cold: breath_period (seconds) / breath_alpha (puffs from people in a cold room), cold_corner_alpha (dusk-blue shadows creeping into corners as the room turns cold or dark). Fire: ember_seconds (real seconds embers glow after the fire goes out). Window: frost and a draught on the floor when open (storybook rooms).
